SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
September 30. 1940
No. 394
1 / 10 / 40

Dear Mr. Yorke

Very many thanks for your
letters of 23rd and 26th September
in reply to my request for inform-
ation regarding the whereabouts
and movements of Messrs. Morris
and Harvey.

Morris has in the meanwhile
visited the Passport Office, while
your understanding that Captain
Dewar-Durie has news regarding
Harvey is correct.

With best regards,
Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

1940 年 9 月 30 日
第 394 号
1940 年 10 月 1 日

亲爱的约克先生：

非常感谢您 9 月 23 日和 26 日的来信，回复了我关于莫里斯（Morris）和哈维（Harvey）两位先生的下落及行踪的信息查询请求。

在此期间，莫里斯已前往护照办公室办理事务，而您获悉杜瓦-杜里（Dewar-Durie）上尉掌握有关哈维的消息，这一理解是正确的。

谨致问候，
您真诚的，

R.W. 约克 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

September 26, 40

Dear Mr. Lamb,

In continuation of my letter dated
September 23, it has been established that ex-
Inspector Morris of the B.M.C. Municipal Police,
Tientsin, is at present residing in Flat 3, No. 29,
Tunsin Road. He has booked passage for Hongkong
per S.S. "Fausang" sailing from Shanghai on
September 29 and it is understood that his ultimate
destination is New Zealand.
I have no definite information of the movements of
ex-Inspector Harvey, but I understand that Captain
R.V. Dewar-Durie is fully informed.

Yours sincerely,
R.D.Y.

L. H. Lamb, Esq.,
Superintending Consul,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1940 年 9 月 26 日

亲爱的兰姆先生：

继我 9 月 23 日的信函之后，现已查明，前天津英租界工部局警务处巡官莫里斯目前居住在敦信路 29 号 3 室。他已预订乘坐 9 月 29 日从上海启航的“Fausang”号轮船前往香港，据悉其最终目的地为新西兰。
我目前没有关于前巡官哈维行踪的确切信息，但我了解到 R.V. 杜瓦-杜里（R.V. Dewar-Durie）上尉对此完全知情。

您真诚的，
R.D.Y.

L. H. 兰姆 先生，
监理领事，
英国驻华总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY File No. 3... S.B. Station 16/9/41 Date Sept. 26, 1940.）

Subject Enquiries regarding movements of W.J. Morris, late of the
Tientsin Police.

Made by D.S. Hocking Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

It has been ascertained that Mr. W. J.
Morris, late of the Tientsin Municipal Police,
is at present in Shanghai, having arrived here
with his wife during the past ten days by train
from Tientsin. He is staying at the home of his
wife's sister, Miss C. Osial, at number 29
Tunsin Road, flat 3. Mr. Morris intends leaving
for New Zealand with the object of taking up
farming. He has booked passage on the s.s.
"Fausang", sailing from Shanghai on September 29
and will tranship on arrival at Hongkong to the
s.s. "Nankin".

（签名：D.S. Hocking）
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处档案室 档案号 3... 特务科站点 1941 年 9 月 16 日 日期 1940 年 9 月 26 日。）

主题：关于前天津警务处人员 W.J. 莫里斯行踪的查询。

由 D.S. 霍金（Hocking）制作 经 D.S.I. 洛根（Logan）转呈

经查实，前天津工部局警务处的 W. J. 莫里斯先生目前在上海，他在过去十天内与妻子乘火车从天津抵达此处。他正借住在其妻妹 C. 奥西尔（C. Osial，音译）小姐家中，地址为敦信路 29 号 3 室。莫里斯先生打算前往新西兰从事农业耕作。他已预订乘坐 9 月 29 日从上海启航的“Fausang”号轮船，并在抵达香港后换乘“南京”号轮船。

（签名：D.S. 霍金）
D. S.

副总监（特务科）

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.
September 21st 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

The Consul-General has just
received a telegram from His
Majesty's Consul-General at
Tientsin to the effect that Police
Inspectors Morris and Harvey,
presumably members of the Tientsin
British Concession Municipal Police,
have resigned and left for Shanghai
leaving many bills unpaid, and that
the Chief of Police has accordingly
suggested that this information
might be conveyed to the Shanghai
Municipal Police for their
information.

Fuller details are promised
by letter, so should there be any-
thing further which might be of
interest or concern to you, I will
let you know in due course.

Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

邮政信箱 259 号，上海。
1940 年 9 月 21 日。

亲爱的约克先生：

总领事刚刚收到英国驻天津总领事发来的电报，称警务巡官莫里斯和哈维（推测为天津英租界工部局警务处成员）已辞职并前往上海，留下许多账单未付，因此警察局长建议将此信息转告上海公共租界工部局警务处知悉。

更详细的细节将通过信件提供，因此如果有任何其他您可能感兴趣或关注的事项，我将适时通知您。

您真诚的，

R.W. 约克 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
